newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa ends off peak, Dec tests 1,000 stg.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa ends off peak, Dec tests 1,000 stg.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa futures retraced from the day's highs on profit-taking but prices still ended slightly higher and traders said the upside potential remained intact.
Traders said the benchmark December tested the psychological 1,000-stg level at one stage but slipped back to end six stg up at 994 stg a tonne on a lack of follow-through buying.
"But it (the rally) doesn't look like it's over yet," said one trader.
The market was also boosted by the latest U.S. CFTC Commitment of Traders report, which showed an increase in speculative, or non-commercial, short positions.
Overall volume reached a moderate 6,828 lots.
"There was good two-way action," said one.
The London Commodity Exchange (LCE) is now trading under the London International Financial Futures Exchange (LIFFE) banner after the merger of the LIFFE and LCE took effect on Monday.
